zh: 支持导入 Windows 端生成的便携索引，街机游戏库可按硬件重新整理。
改进 Pegasus 导入：跳过无效行、识别带时间戳的索引、优先使用标准索引，并按 ROM 路径合并街机记录。
手柄导航覆盖更多菜单和选择操作，输入会发送给最上层的弹窗。
确认时启动当前选中的 ROM 文件，街机压缩包可以直接传给 FBNeo。
修复 Switch 游戏卡模型的外形和塑料质感。
en: Added import of portable indexes generated on Windows, and arcade libraries can be reorganized by hardware.
Improved Pegasus import: invalid lines are skipped, timestamped indexes are found, standard indexes are preferred, and arcade records merge by ROM path.
Controller navigation now covers more menus and selections, and input goes to the top dialog.
Confirming now launches the focused ROM file, and arcade archives pass directly to FBNeo.
Restored the Switch game card shape and softened its plastic finish.
